description: A real Dropbox Business API skill for managed-OAuth access to file operations, sharing, team folder management, member administration, and group management via the Dropbox API.
authorization_notes: File upload writes new content to Dropbox; confirm the target path and file content before uploading.
File move and delete permanently reorganize or remove content; confirm the file path and destination before executing.
Creating a shared link makes file content accessible via URL; confirm the link access level (viewer/editor) and audience restriction before creating.
Team folder creation establishes new shared spaces for the entire team; confirm folder name and member access before creating.
Team member removal can wipe data and transfer ownership; handle with extreme care and explicit authorization.
